title: Open Mic @ Empire
event_description: Tuesday night open mic at Empire in downtown Naperville. All genres welcome. Burger bar with retractable rooftop and live music stage. One of Naperville's hottest restaurants and bars.
event_venue_information:
Empire - Downtown Naperville's Premier Burger Bar and Music Venue

Empire Burgers and Brew has established itself as one of Naperville's hottest restaurants and bars since opening in downtown Naperville. Located at 48 W Chicago Avenue the venue combines a rustic-chic restaurant with an impressive bar and live music stage. The industrial-style interior features reclaimed wood accents creating a vibrant atmosphere that appeals to both diners and music fans.

Tuesday Open Mic Nights

Every Tuesday night Empire hosts open mic starting with sign-ups at 7:30pm. All musicians and genres are welcome to perform. The venue provides professional PA system and microphones. Regular attendees describe the Tuesday open mic as a lot of fun with talented performers. The open mic attracts both experienced musicians and those new to performing creating a supportive community atmosphere.

Live Music Stage and Sound

Empire features a dedicated music stage with professional sound equipment. The venue hosts live performances on its stage adding to the electric atmosphere. Beyond Tuesday open mics Empire books bands and solo artists throughout the week. The stage setup and sound quality make Empire one of the best places to hear live music in Naperville according to local reviews.

Retractable Rooftop Bar

One of Empire's signature features is its retractable rooftop bar. On warm days the deck provides a great spot to relax with friends enjoy drinks and take in the lively downtown Naperville ambiance. The rooftop adds a unique element to the venue making it stand out from typical indoor-only bars and restaurants.

Food and Drink

The menu offers mouth-watering burgers including the popular Gronk burger with double patties cheddar cheese and applewood smoked bacon. The food is generally well-received with items like the tots appetizer earning recommendations. Empire provides a wide selection of beers and craft drinks. Daily happy hour runs from 5pm to 7pm. While the atmosphere is often cited as the highlight the food quality supports the overall experience.

Downtown Naperville Location

Empire sits in the heart of downtown Naperville making it easily accessible and surrounded by shops restaurants and nightlife. The location contributes to the vibrant atmosphere as patrons can walk to and from other downtown destinations. Parking is available along Colorado Boulevard after 6pm and in nearby public lots.
